patterns.name: Declarative node description
patterns.rule: description.properties defines operations and conditional fields.

patterns.name: Shared HTTP wrapper
patterns.rule: Use n8n httpRequest, unwrap result, and enhance errors.

patterns.name: Colocated node test
patterns.rule: Each registered node has a Jest test.

patterns.name: Dynamic options
patterns.rule: A dropdown filled from the API uses typeOptions.loadOptionsMethod; the method lives in a utils helper and is registered in the node's methods.loadOptions. makeApiRequest accepts the loadOptions context.

patterns.name: Fetch-then-put update
patterns.rule: An update whose PUT replaces the record GETs it first and sends the stored values back with the user's fields on top; a collection key the user added is the value to store.
